old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a single tealight candle burning against a pitch-black background. The candle is placed on a dark surface, likely a table or a flat plane, which is barely visible due to the darkness surrounding it. The flame of the candle is steady and bright, casting a warm, yellow-orange glow that illuminates the immediate area around it. The wax at the base of the candle starts to melt, forming a small pool of liquid wax around the wick. The overall atmosphere of the video is serene and intimate, focusing solely on the candle's light and the subtle changes occurring around it. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, and the camera remains stationary throughout, maintaining a consistent focus on the candle and its flame.

caption: The video captures a single lit candle seated in a shallow, scallop-shell-like holder, its wick rising from a pool of melted wax that glows warmly against an otherwise pure black background. A faint watermark text rests in the lower-right corner, and the shell rim, the wax pool, and the wick hold fixed screen positions throughout, with no camera translation or rotation evident. The flame itself is the only luminous element and the focus of the visible change. In the early frames it stands as a short, broad teardrop whose yellow-orange cap sits well below the upper edge of the frame. As the clip proceeds, the flame stretches upward and narrows, its body thinning into a tall, slender spike whose tip climbs toward the top of the image. The pointed apex deepens into a thinner reddish-orange thread while small frame-to-frame flickers modulate its width and outline. The overall trend is one of upward elongation rather than collapse, and the warm glow cast on the wax stays roughly constant as the segment runs.
